rows.text: with the mask byte `1 << cl`, clears that bit in byte `0215FD56` when `edx` is non-zero and sets it when `edx` is zero, storing the byte back; then sets bit 0 of dword `+0x48818` of qword `022C6F28` when the new byte is zero, and clears that bit otherwise

notes: 002EBBF0: the shift is 32-bit (shl r8d, cl) but only its low byte (r8b) is used, so a cl of 8 or more gives a zero mask (set leaves the byte as is; clear leaves it as is too, since NOT 0 is 0xFF). The shl at `002EBBF0+0xD` is not anchored to keep five anchors.
